cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll sit by the door while we talk about trying again. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Knowing I can leave is helping me stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want to come home. Please don't hand me a key yet; saying it is enough for tonight.

mechanism: A directs a reconciliation conversation from a safe exit position, negotiates duration and admits wanting home only while retaining permission to leave without a key.
confusable: Unlike preparing only to flee, A becomes more honest when B allows stopping; the Stance shapes seating and timing through cooperation.
comparison: Returning after separation differs from an unresolved argument in a still-shared home.
seedUse: D119-b door, stopping offer and key boundary; S02-b adjusts the interaction so both can remain engaged.
